answer: Rank trust with short random walks from a few known-honest seed agents, as SybilRank does. Trust flows only along real attestation edges and stops after about log(n) steps, so a nebula of 1,000 fake keys that mostly vouch for one another gets almost nothing: only a trickle crosses the few edges joining it to honest agents. Like light split by a prism, each score breaks down by source seed, so auditors see where it came from. A genuine newcomer, rooted like juniper in real ties, still rises.
